# Repository instructions

- Analyze before modifying files.
- Keep changes small and focused.
- Never commit, push, merge, tag, delete branches, or rewrite Git history.
- Never modify files outside the workspace.
- Never overwrite files under samples, docs/milestones, or docs/archive.
- Run relevant pytest tests after behavioral changes.
- Preserve the vector-first, raster-guided architecture.
- Do not introduce global dilation or generic morphological closing.
- Preserve the M5 topology gate and the separate white-forest semantic layer.
- Use relative or feature-adaptive geometric thresholds.
- Treat outputs, images, DXF files, logs, and metrics as generated artifacts.
